goal: May (drawn young, about five years old) waves with both hands at a low table with a box of crayons, in a bright kindergarten classroom with a green door, low tables, and a wall with big colorful animal pictures and no letters. No letters or words anywhere.
colorPrompt: Compose one children's book picture from the element pictures. Picture 1 is the empty classroom: a cream wall with dark-brown timber beams and a wooden floor. Use it as the background and keep its wall, beams, floor, and camera as they are (ignore any stray rug edge or plant at its border). Picture 2 shows the girl May: the four 3D views at the bottom are the approved character, and the flat drawing at the top is only a hint, so copy the 3D look. Picture 3 shows a box of crayons. Picture 4 shows a low wooden children's table. Picture 5 shows a green classroom door. Picture 6 shows a wall of big colorful animal pictures. Keep the soft, round, bright 3D render look of the pictures, not a 2D drawing and no outlines. Keep May exactly as in the 3D views of picture 2: May: black hair with a fringe and one long ponytail at the side with a small yellow star hair clip, big brown eyes, a small smile, a yellow T-shirt, a blue pleated skirt, white socks, white sneakers; she is five years old and has a chibi look with a big head and a small body. The picture: a full-body shot from the front at a low camera height, in the room of picture 1. May stands slightly left of the middle, faces the camera, and fills about two thirds of the frame height, with her feet on the wooden floor and a soft shadow. She waves hello with BOTH hands: both arms are raised, both hands are open with the palms toward the viewer, each with five clear small fingers and a thumb, and she has a happy small smile. To her right (the right side of the picture) stands the low table of picture 4, as high as her waist, and the box of crayons of picture 3 stands open on the table, large and clearly seen, with colored crayons in it. In the background the green door of picture 5 is in the wall at the far right, and the animal pictures of picture 6 hang on the wall at the left. Hands are small, chubby child hands with five clear short fingers and a thumb when open, never fists unless stated. A hand that reaches toward the camera looks larger because of perspective; that is correct. Clean eye corners with no skin flaps, no streak on the forehead, and no marks on the face. Rendering errors to NOT copy from the character pictures: a tiny dark tick mark or pale skin flap at the outer corner of an eye (the corner next to the ear), and a faint pale crease on a forehead. Each eye ends in a smooth, rounded corner. Nan alone keeps one short, thick, curved eyelash flick at each outer eye corner. The page text is "Hello, I am May." and is context only: do not draw any text. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no writing on any picture or sign. The picture is for young children and is rated G. Every open hand shows exactly five digits: four separate fingers and one thumb. Count them: a hand with three fingers and a thumb is wrong. Both waving hands: the palm faces the viewer, the four fingers are spread a little, and the thumb points out to the side. The ears are smooth, with one clean rounded rim. Each piece of clothing is one even color with no pale patches, no pale blotches at the shoulders, and no stains. Hanging hands are relaxed with separate short fingers and a thumb, not a lump and not a fist. The face has no line, crease, or streak on the forehead, even a faint one.
